Thanks Marissa — we started a staging run and are seeing intermittent 5xx responses from Redwood when we send batched requests to the reranker endpoint. Details below: 

- Endpoint: https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/rerank
- Model: redwood-rerank-l1 (default)
- Observed behavior: ~1-2% of requests return 500 with no body; occurs more frequently when the request payload > ~1.5–2MB.
- Sample request id: fin-req-20260625-472

I've attached a small sample payload and a trimmed log file (finlytics-5xx-sample-payload.json / finlytics-logs-0625.txt). We do use our own HTTP client with a 6s timeout. Could this be a timeout/ingress buffer issue? Also curious whether structured output / tool calling modes change behavior.

Happy to join a technical call if helpful.

Thanks,

Hi Alex / Marissa — thanks for the context and sample artifacts, that was helpful. I ran a quick repro locally and have a few observations and requests: 

1) Repro steps I used (attached as redwood-repro-steps.txt): curl against our staging endpoint with the provided payload in a single POST.
2) Immediate hypothesis: 5xxs align with large payloads that exceed our default request body buffer in the ingress layer. We typically accept chunked transfer but some clients send a single large Content-Length and the proxy times out while assembling upstream.
3) Questions for Finlytics to confirm:
   - Are you sending Content-Length for the full batch or using chunked transfer-encoding?
   - Can you share the exact HTTP headers for a failing request (Auth header trimmed is fine)?
   - Are you using streaming responses or request streaming in the SDK?

4) Short-term mitigations to try now:
   - Increase client timeout to 20s and retry with smaller batch sizes (e.g., max 200 items per batch).
   - Split the payload into multiple smaller requests and use exponential backoff on 5xxs.
   - If you can, try sending with Transfer-Encoding: chunked in a staging test.

5) Long-term action items for us:
   - We'll add an ingress metric and alert for upload size/timeouts and evaluate raising the buffer for this account if needed.
   - If this is a common pattern, we can add guidance in the integration docs for batching heuristics.

Example curl reproducer (minimal):
curl -X POST 'https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/rerank' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary @finlytics-5xx-sample-payload.json

I've attached redwood-repro-steps.txt with the exact commands and the local logs I captured. Let me know the headers and I'll continue triage.

— Camila

Thanks Camila — we ran your curl test and confirmed the following:

- When batch payload size > ~2MB (single POST with Content-Length), we see the 500s consistently.
- When we send the same content split into two requests (~1MB each), requests succeed.
- We are currently sending Content-Length headers (not chunked). Our client library does not default to chunked.

Attached are the updated logs after the reproducer (finlytics-logs-0625.txt). We'll try increasing the client timeout to 20s and switch to smaller batches as you suggested. Happy to test chunked transfer if you think it will help.

Schedule: we can do a follow-up triage call next Tue at 10am PT if that works for your eng team.

— Alex
